Surgeon_Nurse
Anna Lidwin, also known as Sister Lidwin, is an intelligent Zealous Assistant trader in Act Two at the House of Healing.
“
Don't call the doctor yet! I've got potions, sutures - I know I can do this...
„
— Anna Lidwin

Involvement

Anna is located in the Children's Ward of the House of Healing, where she can be found fretting over the 'care' of the dead tieflings  Komira and  Locke. If the tieflings were not saved in Act 1, she will instead be fretting over the body of a nameless goblin.

The party can assure her the 'patients' are alright by passing an ability check:

  • [SLEIGHT OF HAND] Give the corpse a subtle poke. (DC 14)
  • [DECEPTION] I see now - they're sleeping peacefully. I think your work here is already done. (DC 14)
  • [MONK] [DECEPTION] I know this stillness - his body is simply conserving energy as he heals. The patient is stable. (DC 14 )
  • [CLERIC] [DECEPTION] I sense the patient's soul - he is merely resting while his body heals. (DC 14 )
  • [DRUID] [DECEPTION] Ah, you've induced such a peaceful sleep. Your knowledge of herbs is impressive - the doctor would be proud. (DC 14 )

Afterwards she will be available as a Trader. She sells a mix of potions, poisons, Alchemy ingredients and Camping Supplies (many of which are rotten and useless).

Notable items sold

  • Karabasan's Poison
  • Purple Worm Toxin
